description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the “Ratio” (x-axis, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 with tick marks at 0.2 intervals) and the “minFDE₂₀ (←)” metric (y-axis, ranging from 18 to 23 with tick marks at integer intervals), comparing five different model adaptation strategies: Head Tuning (orange line with circle markers), FT (green line with circle markers), LoRA 16 (red line with circle markers), LoRA 64 (purple line with circle markers), and an unlabeled blue line with circle markers. The blue line shows a consistent downward trend, starting at approximately 20.5 at Ratio = 0.0 and decreasing to about 18.1 at Ratio = 1.0. The orange Head Tuning line begins near 23.0, dips slightly to 22.5 around Ratio = 0.6, then rises slightly to 22.7 at Ratio = 1.0. The green FT line starts at 22.2, drops to 21.7 at Ratio = 0.2, rises to 22.0 at Ratio = 0.4, then declines to 21.7 at Ratio = 0.6, remains flat until Ratio = 0.8, and rises to 21.0 at Ratio = 1.0. The red LoRA 16 line begins at 23.0, decreases steadily to 22.0 at Ratio = 0.6, then flattens slightly before rising to 22.2 at Ratio = 1.0. The purple LoRA 64 line starts at 23.0, declines gradually to 22.2 at Ratio = 0.6, then remains nearly flat until Ratio = 1.0, ending at 22.1. All lines use solid lines with circular markers, and the legend is positioned in the upper right quadrant of the plot.
